fields.quote: Multiple logistic regression analyses were applied to evaluate the association between the polymorphisms and the occurrence of infectious events.

items.item_note: The PTX3 null result ('No association was found between SNPs of the PTX3 gene and the analysed infectious events.') comes from the multiple logistic regression described in Methods, which covers all six SNPs. That supports adjusted=yes, but the paper names no covariates, so the call is somewhat inferential. No effect estimates are reported for PTX3.
